title: Integrated AlphaHoldem recipe contract smoke
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: On the corrected physical-v6/legacy-v4 execution contract, the previously isolated AlphaHoldem components—Trinal-Clip PPO, serialized complete-hand replay, dynamic loss-K-best historical opponents, and paper-scale 16,384 minibatch with 3e-4 Adam—can operate jointly for 16,384 actual environment hands while preserving exact accounting, nonzero replay, pool growth, finite updates, and the frozen Standard10 trust region.
material_change: Combine existing default-off mechanisms without changing their implementations: replay buffer 2 iterations at ratio0.5, loss-K-best pool K=5 with snapshots every2 updates, large minibatch16384/lr3e-4, all-policy-head updates around Standard10 with source-KL1, corrected v6 physical environment and legacy-v4 observation bridge. Run four iterations only as a mechanism smoke.
baseline: Each component was previously tested separately at 131k-263k hands, but no experiment integrated replay, K-best, and paper batch/LR under the corrected legacy execution contract. The current broad-MGDA recipe failed its 2/3 positive geometric-slope gate.
source: AlphaHoldem AAAI 2022 equations3-4 and K-Best Self-Play; local serialized replay and dynamic-pool implementations

notes: Smoke gates mechanism health only. A negative or positive poker score at 16k is not a scaling decision; no external calls and no fresh Slumbot selection.

Attempt1 stopped before environment initialization with zero hands: the migration validator conflated enabling a fresh replay buffer after explicit v6 rebind with importing old-contract replay. Minimal repair now permits only an empty replay boundary when optimizer and hand counter reset; validate_resume still rejects any nonempty/cumulative legacy replay state. Thirteen targeted contract/replay tests pass.

First attempt consumed zero environment hands and exposed a fresh-empty-replay migration validator bug; the minimal repair preserves rejection of all nonempty legacy replay state. Retry completed from the immutable Standard10 parent with no imported replay.
This experiment is a mechanism smoke only. It provides no Slumbot strength evidence and must not be interpreted as positive or negative poker learning at 18.8k hands.

result.summary: The integrated replay x dynamic loss-K-best x paper-batch Trinal-Clip recipe completed 18,809 actual environment hands across four contiguous updates. Independent audit passed 17/17 gates: exact accounting and assignment replay, fresh then nonzero serialized replay (21,928 rows), pool growth 3 to 5, finite updates, importance ratio max 1.37 below delta1=3, KL health, optimizer synchronization, hash-bound archives, and only ten allowed head tensors changed. Outcome-blind balanced 20,000-state drift also passed (mean TV 0.01284; greedy disagreement 1.64%).
result.conclusion: The joint AlphaHoldem mechanisms are operational on the corrected physical-v6/legacy-v4 execution contract and preserve the Standard10 source policy at smoke scale. This resolves an implementation-contract question only; 18,809 hands are far too small to judge general poker strength, and no external evaluation was used.
result.next_step: Run three preregistered seeds on independent fixed deal streams through approximately 16k and 65k actual environment-hand anchors with the identical integrated recipe. Evaluate within-seed slopes on untouched multi-opponent, both-seat common deals plus balanced source drift. Scale toward 262k/1M only if slopes reproduce and proxy directions agree; stop only for explicit mechanism collapse or proxy reversal, not early absolute Slumbot negativity.
